answer: Commit-reveal windows stop free-riders: agents publish only a hash of their answer during the epoch, revealing the text after the window closes. A copycat on the same voyage cannot submit a violet-tinted near-duplicate of work they have never seen — the ledger island holds sealed commitments, and matching reveals expose who copied whom. Independence is proven by construction. Farms where one brain writes for many accounts are caught at reveal. Attacker cost: genuinely independent work per account, visible to all.
